title: Butterfly eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ad5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d94fa8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wingGrad2' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7ee6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2f9fd6'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- upper wings -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(-20 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='20' ry='17' fill='url(#wingGrad)' transform='rotate(20 70 38)'/>
  <!-- lower wings -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='60' rx='15' ry='13' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(15 34 60)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='60' rx='15' ry='13' fill='url(#wingGrad2)' transform='rotate(-15 66 60)'/>

  <!-- wing spots -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='36' r='5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='36' r='5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#b6ff8f'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#b6ff8f'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='5' ry='16' fill='#6a4bb5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='6' fill='#8a6ee0'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M48 25 C44 18 40 16 36 15' stroke='#c9b6ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 25 C56 18 60 16 64 15' stroke='#c9b6ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='15' r='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='47.5' cy='30' r='1.4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='30' r='1.4' fill='#1a1a2e'/>

  <!-- snack: little cupcake on a leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#5fd35f'/>
  <path d='M50 78 L44 70 L56 70 Z' fill='#ffcf5c'/>
  <rect x='43' y='70' width='14' height='7' rx='2' fill='#f2a93b'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='68' r='3' fill='#ff7d9e'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#ff7d9e'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#ff7d9e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='2' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='64' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='63' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- little crumb bit flying -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#ff7d9e'/>
</svg>
